text.tspan: Figure 9: ICON-D2's advantage over ICON-EU shrinks within hours of each

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'ICON-D2's mean absolute error minus ICON-EU's. Both run every 3 hours, so at each hour both are served at the same lead. Rows other than all hours were added after the first run. Filled: 1 h lead; pale and hollow: 2 h and 3 h. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Six solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to August 2026. Planned: one of the comparisons written into the study plan before any result existed. Every other row is exploratory.'
